name: parallel_leader_participation
description: Controls whether the leader backend participates in executing subplans under Gather or Gather Merge nodes, or only gathers results from parallel workers.
symptoms: Suboptimal CPU utilization on multi-core systems
Longer query latency for short-to-medium duration parallel queries
Increased coordinator overhead when leader is idle
tuning_tips: Enable (on) to improve throughput for queries where leader participation reduces overall latency; disable (off) if leader contention or memory pressure occurs during high-concurrency parallel workloads.
